title: UP Launches 'Mukhyamantri Shikshak Cashless Chikitsa Yojana' (₹5 Lakh Medical Cover)
summary: Provides cashless medical treatment up to ₹5 lakh/year for 15 lakh teachers and staff.

blocks.content: Provides cashless medical treatment up to ₹5 lakh/year for 15 lakh teachers and staff.

items: Cashless Benefit: Up to ₹5 lakh per year medical cover at empanelled hospitals for 15 lakh basic/secondary teachers and staff.
SBI Social Security MoU: SBI partnership provides group term insurance and accident cover to 10 lakh teachers.
DBT Student Transfer: Transferred ₹1,320 crore via DBT to 1.10 crore students (₹1,200/student for uniforms/stationery).

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Uttar Pradesh is the first state to provide comprehensive cashless medical and social security to its entire teaching workforce.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: Cashless medical cover cap (₹5 lakh/yr) vs student DBT transfer (₹1,200/student).
